definitions: The eighteenth letter of the English alphabet.
A symbol for the set of real numbers.
An abbreviation for 'right' or 'rear' (in directions or positions).
An abbreviation for 'recipe' or 'take' (in medical prescriptions).
An abbreviation for 'R-rated' (referring to a movie rating).
examples: R is the set of real numbers.
Turn R at the next light.
